The '''leader''' of the [[Rath Cartel]], a criminal syndicate active during the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic]], was [[Assassin/Legends|assassinated]] on the orders of the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Nok Drayen]] at the end of the [[Syndicate Wars]], simultaneous with Drayen's assault on the [[Vandelhelm Combine]]'s headquarters.
